title: CandidateDiscussion
description: A discussion thread entry attached to a CandidatePool or a specific pool member. Discussion threads drive collaborative review and research tasking; they do not place orders.

subject_type.description: 'pool' for a pool-level discussion; 'member' for a candidate-specific thread.

pool_id.description: Pool context; always present for member-level discussions.

parent_discussion_id.description: ID of the parent thread entry when this is a reply.

author.description: Operator or persona ID that created this discussion entry.

body.description: Markdown body of the discussion entry.

kind.description: Semantic kind of the entry; used by the BFF to surface actionable items.
